_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Pinned ~50 momentum/funding and dead ETF flows mark a coil, not a trend; base case is range-hold one rung into Complacency unless a breaker fires.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative has no forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound and fear/greed holds 45-55 with no ETF-flow or funding impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: a range break with fear/greed leaving 40-60 or ETF flows reversing sharply off 1
